Time for a little Critters bedtime story before I call it a night and ring in early for the launch of the game.

The last couple years in crypto have been extremely difficult for builders. Access to capital is basically non-existent. 

Just to give you an idea what's at stake for the launch tomorrow I will share some of the project's lore for those who haven't been following.

Everybody involved with this project is all in. From the community to the team to myself to Matt. 

I'm in over $500k cash and I'm socially all in. The team has been working practically for free the last several months. Matt had to sell his car a couple weeks ago to pay bills. 

The community stepped up multiple times. There's a core group that patiently staked for the past two years without much hesitation. 

They even opted in to a deal open to all where they were able to trade the rights to their unlocked tokens in exchange for a piece of the action in the mining protocol. A little under half of the community opted in.

In only 3 days they have earned over 200 SOL. And then last week they came together to raise 2000 SOL which went entirely to the Quest pair as locked liquidity. 

And now 3 days later the SOL liquidity has risen to 5000. This is all happening organically because there's no KOL or major Media budget for marketing. 

It's just me and a few believers telling genuine stories about how they've been treated the past couple years by Matt and the team.

To quote the late great Robert Hunter, "Let it be known, there is a fountain that was not made by the hands of men."

Gn

tweets.text:
The “fat app” thesis is finally showing up in the revenue data

Value is moving up the stack from blockspace into the apps where users actually trade, borrow, launch, pay & speculate

Agents push this one step further

- Today a power user might manually interact with 20 different apps
